notes.subject: תושב
notes.rationale: תושב (man i stap long ples, tasol i no man bilong ples) vs גר long v48 (man bilong narapela ples) — tupela tok i tanim wankain long ol olding translation, tasol Hebri i tokim narapela kain man.

notes.subject: lo bilong Pesak
notes.rationale: Lo i tok stret long man bilong ol lain, em i lo tasol i no gat toksave long wanwan man.

translation: Man i stap long ples na man bilong wok bilong pe, ol i no ken kaikai long em.

tokens.gloss: na man bilong wok bilong pe
